The following events took place in '''3630 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Alliance Commander|The Commander's]] [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] continues its campaign against the [[Eternal Empire]].<ref name="KOTFE 10" />
*[[Tenebrae|Vitiate]], the former [[Sith Emperor/Legends|Sith Emperor]], dies for what is thought to be the last time on [[Zakuul]] in a confrontation with [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]].<ref name="KOTET 9" />
*The [[Eternal Empire]] is reorganized into the [[Eternal Alliance]].<ref name="KOTET 9" />
*The [[Reclamation Service Yavin 4 expedition]]<ref name="Fighting Power With Knowledge">{{TORcite|type=general|Fighting Power With Knowledge|[[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In '''Chapter VIII: End Times''' of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'', the player has to choose between saving [[Torian Cadera]] or [[Vette]]. In the Iokath expansion, the player has to choose to side with either the Sith Empire or the Galactic Republic, which would lead either to the death of Empress Acina or [[Jace Malcom]].
